title: Hi-Lo Blackjack Deviation Index (game-type parameterized)
description: Deeply-researched, cross-source-verified index of Hi-Lo (High-Low) card-counting deviations from basic strategy, spanning game types. Each record is a superset of the app IndexPlay contract (src/types/index.ts): same id/kind/total/pairRank/upcard/comparator/action/basicAction fields, extended with per-ruleset index values (indexS17/indexH17) and rule/deck gating so a builder can project it onto any game type.
generatedBy: multi-agent deep-research workflow (deviations-index-research); 12 agents, cross-checked vs Schlesinger Blackjack Attack 3e, Wong Professional Blackjack, Wizard of Odds, Blackjack Apprenticeship

baseline.note: All indexS17/indexH17 values are balanced Hi-Lo TRUE-COUNT boundaries at this baseline. True-count indices are deck-count independent for 4/6/8-deck shoes (see gameTypeNotes for the SD/DD caveat).

fieldSchema.id: string — stable id, app convention: hard<total>v<up>, soft<total>v<up>, pair<rank>v<up>, surr<total>v<up>, 'insurance'. Upcard 11 = Ace; ten pair rank = '10'.
fieldSchema.spot: string — human-readable label, e.g. "16 v 10", "A,7 v 2".
fieldSchema.dealerUpcard: number 2..10, 11 for Ace; null for insurance.
fieldSchema.playerTotal: number — hard/soft total; null for pair/insurance.
fieldSchema.action: action taken WHEN the deviation triggers ('hit'|'stand'|'double'|'split'|'surrender').
fieldSchema.basicAction: basic-strategy action when it does NOT trigger (the non-triggering fallback). Matches the multi-deck S17 basic chart.
fieldSchema.comparator: 'gte' => deviate when trueCount >= index (rich-deck plays AND lower-bound stiff-stands with negative index); 'lte' => deviate when trueCount <= index (poor-deck plays only). NOTE: 13v2/13v3/12v5/12v6 are 'gte' with a negative index (stand at/above, hit below) — NOT lte.
fieldSchema.indexS17: integer boundary true count under Dealer-Stands-Soft-17; null when the play does not exist under S17.
fieldSchema.indexH17: integer boundary true count under Dealer-Hits-Soft-17; equals indexS17 for the majority of plays; null when the play is basic strategy (no deviation) or does not exist under H17.
fieldSchema.requiresDAS: boolean — true if the play only holds when Double-After-Split is offered (low-pair splits only).
fieldSchema.requiresSurrender: boolean — true if the play needs late surrender offered (all surrender lines).
fieldSchema.sources: array of named authoritative sources supporting the value(s).
fieldSchema.notes: string — source disagreement, rounding, encoding, or ruleset caveats.

tagLegend.illustrious18: Don Schlesinger's Illustrious 18 — the 18 highest-EV Hi-Lo deviations plus insurance.
tagLegend.catch22: Members of the commonly-cited extended "Catch 22" index set.
tagLegend.extended: Extended / fuller Hi-Lo index beyond the core sets; lower reach/EV.

wiring.appContract: src/types/index.ts -> IndexPlay; consumed by src/engine/deviations.ts (INDEX_PLAYS), strategy.ts, drillEngine.ts, chartSpots.ts.
wiring.projection: To produce the app's S17 INDEX_PLAYS array: filter this.deviations where indexS17 !== null, and for the S17 ruleset map each record to IndexPlay as { id, kind, total: playerTotal ?? undefined, pairRank: pairRank ?? undefined, upcard: dealerUpcard ?? undefined, index: indexS17, comparator, action, basicAction, description: notes-or-spot }. For H17, use indexH17 and drop records where indexH17 === null. Respect requiresSurrender/requiresDAS against Settings.surrenderEnabled/dasEnabled, and honor deviationRange as today.
wiring.uniqueness: The app keys findIndexPlay() uniquely on (kind, total/pairRank, upcard) and takes the FIRST match. This data set intentionally records BOTH a stand line and a surrender line for the same spot (e.g. hard15v10 + surr15v10, hard16v9 + surr16v9). When building the flat INDEX_PLAYS, pick ONE per (kind,total/pairRank,upcard) per the app's existing rule (surrender line canonical when surrender is on; otherwise the stand line) — do not emit both into the flat array.
wiring.caution: Entries with confidence:"low" (single-source or uncorroborated, several tagged as removal candidates in notes) and the deep-negative surrender floors are for completeness; gate them behind a review before drilling users on them.

gameTypeNotes: Baseline is 6-deck S17 DAS LS, balanced Hi-Lo, pivot TC 0, insurance +3. RULES drive the indices, not deck count. S17 vs H17: most of the I18 is identical across both (insurance +3, 16v10 0, 15v10 +4, 16v9 +4/+5, 12v2 +3, 12v3 +2, 12v4 0, 12v5 -2, 12v6 -1, 13v2 -1, 13v3 -2, 9v2 +1, 9v7 +3, 10v10 +4, TTv5 +5, TTv6 +4 all unchanged). Only about seven spots shift under H17: 11vA (S17 +1 double becomes basic-strategy double under H17 -> indexH17 null); 10vA (+4 -> +3); 16vA stand (impractical/none under S17 -> +3 under H17); 15vA stand (none under S17 -> +5 under H17); 15vA surrender (S17 +1/+2 -> H17 -1); A,8 v6 double (S17 +1 gte -> basic double under H17); and 17vA becomes a basic-strategy surrender under H17 (always, not a count deviation, so not tabulated here). DECK COUNT: one shared true-count table is correct for 4/6/8 decks because dividing running count by decks-remaining normalizes card density; insurance is +3 in every deck count. Single/double deck can differ by a point on some 12/16 and split plays (larger composition effects) and practitioners often run running-count indices there, so SD/DD warrants a separate RC-index mode. DAS gates low-pair splits only (6,6 v2; 4,4 v5/v6; 3,3 v2/v3; 2,2 v2/v3): with DAS they split at lower/negative counts, without DAS the index rises or the split disappears; tens-splits, 9,9, 8,8 and A,A are DAS-independent. LS gates all surrenders (Fab 4 plus the extended surrenders); with no surrender each falls back to its hard-total hit/stand line; 16v9/16v10/16vA are basic-strategy surrenders when LS is on, and 17vA is a basic surrender only under H17. CONVENTIONS: floored Schlesinger integers are canonical; every stiff-stand and every rich-deck double/split/surrender/insurance is encoded gte, including the negative-index lower-bound stands (13v2 -1, 13v3 -2, 12v5 -2, 12v6 -1) which are stand-at/above, hit-below and must NOT be mislabeled lte; the single genuine lte no-double case is A,8 v6 under H17 (basic doubles, stop doubling at deep-negative counts).

deviations.notes: I18 #1. Take insurance/even-money at TC>=+3; deck- and rule-independent. action/basicAction are placeholders; app keys off kind='insurance'.
I18 #2 (Big 3). Basic hits; stand at TC>=0. S17=H17.
I18 #3 (Big 3). Stand at TC>=+4. Distinct from the Fab 4 surrender 15v10 line (surr15v10). S17=H17.
I18 #4. Basic stands the 20; split tens at TC>=+5. Not DAS-dependent. High casino heat. S17=H17.
I18 #5. Split tens at TC>=+4. Report lists TTv6 among unchanged S17/H17 hands; a minority put H17 ~+3. Kept +4/+4. Not DAS-dependent.
I18 #6. Hard 10 vs 10; double at TC>=+4. S17=H17.
I18 #7. Basic hits 12v3; stand at TC>=+2. S17=H17.
I18 #8. Basic hits 12v2; stand at TC>=+3. S17=H17.

I18 #9. S17: basic hits, double at TC>=+1 (Wizard/Schlesinger, high confidence). H17: 11vA is basic-strategy double, so no deviation exists -> indexH17 null per the game-type report (researchers had variously encoded 0 or -1 as 'always double').
I18 #10. Double at TC>=+1. GameMaster's +2 is a minority; kept canonical +1. Dealer 2 barely touched by soft-17 rule; S17=H17.
I18 #11. Genuine S17/H17 split: double at TC>=+4 (S17), TC>=+3 (H17, dealer ace stronger). Both corroborated.
I18 #12. Double at TC>=+3. S17=H17.
I18 #13. Stand at TC>=+5 (Schlesinger/Wong/Wizard/gamblingcalc majority). Blackjack Apprenticeship floored charts round to +4 (see unresolved). S17=H17.

I18 #14. Lower-bound stand: gte with negative index -> STAND at TC>=-1, HIT at TC<=-2. basicAction='hit' is the below-index (non-triggering) action per engine convention; do not 'fix' to stand. S17=H17.
I18 #15. Lower-bound stand, gte 0: STAND at TC>=0, HIT below. S17=H17.
I18 #16. Lower-bound stand, gte -2: STAND at TC>=-2, HIT below. BJA practical charts omit it. S17=H17.

I18 #17. Lower-bound stand, gte -1: STAND at TC>=-1, HIT below. indexH17 set to -1 per the game-type report, which lists 12v6 among UNCHANGED S17/H17 hands; one researcher had argued a drop to -3 (see unresolved).
I18 #18 (lowest EV). Lower-bound stand, gte -2: STAND at TC>=-2, HIT below. S17=H17.
Fab 4. Surrender at TC>=+3, else hit. casinonewsdaily lists +4 (rounded). BJA S17/H17 charts omit row 14 as too marginal to chart. S17=H17.
Fab 4. 15v10 is basic LS in S17, so this is a floor: surrender at TC>=0, hit below (BJA '0-'). basicAction=hit is the below-floor play. Coexists with the I18 stand line hard15v10. S17=H17.
Fab 4. Deviate TO surrender at TC>=+2 (BJA S17/H17 both '2+'). casinonewsdaily +3 is an outlier. S17=H17.

Fab 4, large real S17/H17 split. S17: deviate to surrender at +2 (BJA/casinonewsdaily); Schlesinger floored gives +1 (see unresolved). H17: 15vA is basic LS -> floor at -1 (surrender at TC>=-1, hit below).
Extended LS. Deviate to surrender at TC>=+4 (BJA S17/H17 both '4+'). Coexists with the extended stand line hard16v8. Some lists give +5. S17=H17.
Extended LS. 16v9 is basic LS in both rulesets -> surrender floor at -1 (BJA '-1-'), gte convention. Some lists put the floor at 0. Coexists with I18 stand hard16v9. S17=H17.

Extended LS. 16v10 is basic LS in both rulesets ('SUR' = surrender at all practical counts); the deep negative floor at which you'd stop is unpublished (forum ~ -2 to -4). Effectively always surrender. Coexists with I18 stand hard16v10.

Extended LS. 16vA is basic LS in both rulesets ('SUR', surrender at all counts); only a deep-negative floor (approx S17 -4, H17 -5, H17 deeper) stops surrender. Integers approximate. Coexists with stand hard16vA.

deviations.notes: Index-triggered double. GameMaster +3 vs WoV DD-H17 +1 (see unresolved). Kept +3, low confidence. Non-Ace, S17=H17.
High-count soft-20 double at TC>=+6; monotonic with v5/v6 (+5/+4). Dealer 4 rarely reaches soft 17, S17~H17. Exact integer print-only, medium confidence.
Soft-20 double vs 5 at TC>=+5; fits +4/+5/+6 progression. Minor H17 effect, kept 5/5. Medium confidence.
Soft-20 double vs 6 at TC>=+4 (S17); dealer 6 can reach soft 17 so H17 ~+3 (direction correct). Some charts keep +4 for both. Medium confidence.
Soft-19 double vs 4, classic S17/H17 divergence (H17 lower). Sources spread ~+4 to +6 S17; the game-type report tabulates +3 unchanged (see unresolved). Kept researcher 5/3, low confidence.
Soft-19 double vs 5. Some lists ~+5 S17; game-type report tabulates +1 unchanged (see unresolved). Kept researcher 3/1, low confidence.

S17: basic stands, double at TC>=+1 (gte). H17: doubling A,8 v6 is basic strategy so no rich-deck deviation -> indexH17 null (matches soft18v2/soft17v2). The game-type report instead flags an H17 poor-deck lte 'stop-doubling' play at negative counts (see unresolved).
S17 basic stands; double at TC>=+1. Under H17 A,7 v2 is basic-strategy double -> indexH17 null. S17 integer cited 0 to +2; kept +1, low confidence.
Soft-18 stand vs 9: basic hits, stand at TC>=+3 (gte). Dealer 9 cannot form soft 17, S17=H17. Minor play, low confidence on integer.
S17: basic hits, stand at TC>=+1 (gte). Under H17 the dealer hits soft 17, making standing on 18 vs A worse -> always hit, no reachable stand deviation, indexH17 null.
S17 basic hits vs 2; double at TC>=+1. Under H17 A,6 v2 is basic-strategy double -> indexH17 null. S17 integer ~+1, low confidence.
6D S17 basic hits vs 4; double at high count (~+5 to +6), H17 a couple lower (direction correct). Single-source, integer unverified.
6D S17 basic already doubles vs 5, so this is a near-break-even floor (double at/above ~0, hit below); true crossover slightly negative, index 0 approximate. Low confidence.
6D S17 basic hits vs 4; double at high count (~+4 to +5), H17 slightly lower. Single-source, low confidence.
6D S17 basic already doubles vs 5; near-zero floor like A,2 v5. Index 0 approximate, low confidence.
Extended split-tens completing the series (v6 +4, v5 +5, v4 +6). Split at TC>=+6, S17=H17. Very high heat, rarely arises. Not part of core I18.

Late-surrender deviation: surrender 8,8 v 10 at TC>=+1 (Wong NDAS, both S17/H17). Merged the duplicate surr88v10 record (which gave 0) into this entry; CVData shows 0 (see unresolved). With DAS the index rises to ~+2. When surrender is offered it overrides splitting.

No-surrender line: above TC>=+8 stop splitting and stand on the 16. Kept as a separate entry from the surrender line pair8v10 (distinct action). Relevant only when LS unavailable; risk-averse figure, marginal EV.

Under H17 8,8 vA is basic LS (not a count deviation) and the count play reverses to split at high count, so the deviate-to-surrender framing does not apply -> indexH17 null. Low confidence, candidate for removal. (id uses pair-namespace to avoid colliding with hard surr16vA.)
Basic stands (18 vs likely 17). GameMaster gives 'split at 6' (risk-averse); EV-max sources ~+3, so true index likely lower. DAS-independent. Kept +6, low confidence.
DAS-gated: basic splits 6,6 v2, poor-deck deviation is HIT at TC<=-2 (lte). blackjackreview says '-2 or lower', blackjackinfo mirror says '-1'. Requires DAS. Low value.
DAS-gated: basic splits 3,3 v2, deviation is HIT at TC<=0 (lte). Both mirrors agree on 0. Requires DAS. Marginal.
DAS-gated: basic splits 4,4 v5, deviation is HIT (lte). blackjackreview says 0, blackjackinfo mirror -1. Requires DAS. Low value.
DAS-gated: basic splits 4,4 v6, deviation is HIT at TC<=-2 (lte). Both mirrors agree. Requires DAS. Low value.

unresolved.issue: S17 index disputed: Schlesinger floored gives +1 (the game-type report recommends this), while the Blackjack Apprenticeship S17 chart and casinonewsdaily give +2. Entry kept at +2; H17 (-1) is agreed.
S17 index disputed: researcher/GameMaster corroborate ~+3, but the game-type report treats the S17 stand as impractical (~+7, rarely reached). H17 (+3) is agreed. Entry kept at 3/3.

Whether an S17 stand deviation exists at all: researcher gives +5 for both rulesets, but the game-type report says 15v10... 15vA only becomes a stand play under H17 (+5) and is null/impractical under S17. Entry kept at 5/5.

H17 encoding disputed: treated here as indexH17 null (doubling is H17 basic strategy, no rich-deck deviation), but the game-type report argues a genuine poor-deck lte 'stop-doubling' play at negative counts under H17. A single record cannot hold both an S17 gte double (+1) and an H17 lte no-double.
H17 index disputed: game-type report lists 12v6 among UNCHANGED hands (H17 = S17 = -1, adopted here), but a category researcher argued H17 drops to -3 on directional dealer-6 bust-rate reasoning.
Rounding disagreement: Schlesinger/Wong/Wizard/gamblingcalc give +5 (adopted); Blackjack Apprenticeship floored charts give +4.
Wong (1994) gives +1 (adopted); Casino Verite CVData built-in Wong index shows 0.

Wong/GameMaster values (+9 / +6 / +3, adopted) conflict with a Wizard of Vegas DD-H17 list (+5 / +3 / +1); given near deck-independence of TC indices the lower figures are credible, so these integers are unverified.

Absolute value and H17 behavior disputed: researcher gives 5/3 and 3/1 (H17 lower); the game-type report tabulates +3 and +1 unchanged across S17/H17. Entries kept at researcher values, low confidence.
